chk.text: Tor Wauki, Tetsuo Umezawa's second, travels to Sekana at the start of the Madara-Edemi War and fails to parley with Wasitora, and then an Elder Land Wurm announces the Edemi rebellion and the group together kills it.
Tor travels with Tetsuo and Ayesha to Kusho, and he is separated from Tetsuo as punishment and put to work in the kentsu under Halfdane, who has replaced Barktooth Warbeard.
Xira strikes Tor down while Halfdane, in Tor's guise, shoots Kei dead, and Kei's last healing spell saves Tor, who wakes from his coma and secretly rebels against Halfdane's cruelty.
With Ayesha, Tor lures Halfdane into a trap and banishes him with black mana, and the two return to Madara to celebrate its liberation and rejoin Tetsuo and Kolo Meha in Sekana.
